reviews.x: AMAZING. i’m in high school, and after gym my face get so red no matter what we do. Even if I’m not even sweating, my face is red. I use these wipes the my face to help myself cool down, and they work very well. One side is rather bumpy and the other is smooth. Not sure wjat the bumps are for, probs for sort of a “scrub” if you actually are using it in place of a shower lol. But great cooling cleansing wipe! Love it. Expensive, but they work well.

Okay these are some good wipes. Explain why they lost two stars.  Price. At 12 bucks for 25 they are a little bit pricey.  I didnt really notice much if a cooling effect.  About on par with grocery store bathroom wipes honestly.  Better quality but priced 6x as much.  If price is no factor there 4 stars.  Sorry couldnt say i recommend them.  Glad they give money to military though.

reviews.t: Good product with a few issues
reviews.x: The scent is pleasant and mild, and the cooling effect does happen to a degree. That said, these wipes aren't very big, so to clean my whole body I really need 2-3.  They also seem to evaporate fairly soon after removal from the package, so I have to make sure I use them right away. Finally, I don't think these glide particularly well along the skin. They kind of bunch up or stick, especially with the (much appreciated) exfoliating side of the wipe.  These aren't bad by any means, but I'm not en

reviews.t: Buyin again. Best thing to buy for work!
reviews.x: This was the best thing I bought since my Veloster! Working in a medical supplies warehouse can get a bit heated.. especially if it’s you and one other dude. Got in 12 pallets of PPE and 20 pounds of medicine with all sorts of lots. Melting from the brain down. This makes my 15 min much better. Cools you off with any sort of breeze for a little while. Also since wearing a mask everyday and sweating, use this you get refreshed and you won’t get so many Clogged pores

Good product, buy kind of expensive for what it is.  Appears to me that it is a baby wipe that smells of an adult scent.  I have found it hard to get only one wipe out of the package at a time (usually two (2) come out).  Think I will continue with unscented baby wipes that are a little larger, cheaper and have a higher wipe count.

reviews.t: I do love it! Those bubbly layer on a tissue are ...
reviews.x: Thank you for your product. I do love it! Those bubbly layer on a tissue are amazing, cleaned my skin perfectly fine.

*update* cools much better than competitors and feels extremely clean and non drying for your face. Excellent product. issues getting it shipped to canada thought. don't know why i could buy before and when i hit reorder it says can't ship to canada...  The package is nicely sized and easy to pull a single towel out at a time. reseals easy and airtight. Towels smell nice and nicely damp without being dripping wet. coarse side and smooth side work well.  Once applied I felt a little cooling then

I've got a medical condition that makes me heat intolerant, so this summer's heat wave has been challenging. I bought these to give them a shot, and I have to say that I really like them. The smell is kind of outdoorsy and menthol, and they definitely have a cooling effect on the skin. I wouldn't try to use these to replace a shower, like some reviews have said, but I have used them on pulse points for quick cooling- back of the knees, neck, under arms, etc. I would've given them 5 stars if they

reviews.t: Not one of Duke/Cannon's best products
reviews.x: Duke/Cannon, I am avid supporter of your products. However, this one is not one of your best. I keep these wipes in the vehicle. They smell great and feel cool. However, they leave a sticky film on my hands which is not pleasant – like a bad, sticky hand sanitizer. I have also tried them as body wipes. Feel great initially as they are cooling, but leave me feeling still dirty. They are also expensive per item. Unscented baby wipes will do the same thing way cheaper.

reviews.t: It has a nice mint (not as strong as peppermint) scent and little ...
reviews.x: I got it for a late-summer trip to Europe. It was still humid and hot for me and hoping this towels would help. It helped a little bit. It has a nice mint (not as strong as peppermint) scent and little textures on the towels helped feeling refreshed and cooled down a tiny bit. I do not think it has a significant advantage over using regular wet tissues. Maybe it dries clearer then wet tissue? For the price, it was an underwhelming experience.

Took this to a festival and it was exactly what I needed. Perfect for cleaning up dusty feet from walking in sandals all day without needing to shower every day. Smelled nice too, not feminine. Will need to stock up again for the next trip.
They are ok, gives you a cool feeling, do t know if they clean good enough. They do have a exfoliating side and soft side, was looking for something to give me a more cleaner feel.
These are supposed to be “cooling”; that means MINTY. These are not. In fact they smell terrible and have no “cooling” effect at all. Just wet wipes that smell like bug spray.
I love these things!!! Now if I could only get them on my subscription so I don't have to remember to reorder them. I lover the cooling soap blocks too
Made for a fun gift for my stinky husband.  He keeps in his soccer bag to "towel off" before getting back into his car.  He's pretty gross.
These are amazing! Definitely helped clean all the sand and wear off while being in the field.

I LOVE these! My husband got me a pack of the single use, individually wrapped version and the first time I used them, I was hooked! They’re wonderful for camping and hiking and I love the resealable wipe bag option. The scrubby side is nice for getting caked on dirt and mud. Shared some with a friend and he described them as a “perfect mixture of spearmint and carhartt!”

These are great. A rough side and a soft side depending on what you're freshening up. Very strong material that won't break apart like some other wipes. Good clean masculine scent. Perfect for a quick wipe down after a particularly messy activity or as a quick in between showers. I keep a pack in my truck JIC

The cold shower sheets are perfect for cleansing your face each morning and night before applying creams and/or makeup. They are mostly used when traveling or camping when you cannot take a full shower or just want to freshen up.

I expected a larger "towel." Disappointed.  These are about the size of moistened personal wipes, the illusion of size the name suggests is misleading.  Neither soft or nicely fragrant.  Just more wipes but a bit but thicker.

Great product as most all duke and cannon products are. Perfect for athletes or blue collar hard working jobs for a good refreshing cleansing wipe. Would recommend to athletes and guy who work in hard harsh environments
I enjoy having a pack of these for the gym when I’m able to go straight home and shower, wish the wipes were bigger but overall great product to have in my bad
Bought these for a friend who was going through a period of being hot and sweaty, and she couldnt get cool. Gave her these, and she loved them.

reviews.t: Not sure if I got a bad batch or what but they were pretty dry
reviews.x: Not sure if I got a bad batch or what but they were pretty dry. They do smell good I'd imagine if I got some fresh ones they'd be great
Cool and tingles.  Not as big as the dude wipes so I end up using two. Still a great product and a better deal. Will buy it again.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the wipes provide a cooling effect and enjoy the scent.
Several reviewers consider the product overpriced for what it is.
Some reviewers report the wipes are small, dry out quickly, or dispense multiple at once.
A few reviewers say the cooling effect is weak or absent and dislike the smell.
Some reviewers note a sticky residue or question how well the wipes actually clean.
